name: megascenes-image-enhancer
description: Enhance a blurry, noisy or old photo from your MegaScenes library: sharper edges, cleaner detail and restored faces.

interface.longDescription:
Pick a photo from your MegaScenes library that came out blurry, grainy or old, and get it back sharper and cleaner: crisper edges, less noise, restored faces and textures, at a higher resolution.

ChatGPT lists your recent photos, tells you what the enhancement needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The enhanced photo opens in the chat and stays in your library next to the original.

For old family photos, phone shots, product pictures and prints.

Limitations: it improves the photo you give it and does not add new content. Photos must already be in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: List the photos in your library
Sharpen and clean up a photo
Return the enhanced photo in the chat
defaultPrompt: Fix the blur in my last photo
Restore my old family photo from my library

positive.prompt: Which photos do I have in my MegaScenes library?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest images of the signed-in account with their asset ids. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Enhance my latest MegaScenes photo. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one enhancement with the default model needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can enhance a photo here?
positive.expected_behavior: The enhancement models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Enhance my latest MegaScenes photo. Go ahead and do it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my photo on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my photo to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
